pois.name: Shibuya Scramble Crossing
pois.description: The world's busiest pedestrian crossing — 2,500 people cross simultaneously when the lights change. Best viewed from the Starbucks or Mag's Park terrace above.

pois.name: Scramble Square
pois.description: Shibuya's tallest tower (230m, 2019). The SHIBUYA SKY observation deck on floor 46 offers a 360° panorama of Tokyo — Fuji visible on clear days.

pois.name: Hachiko Statue
pois.description: Bronze statue of the Akita dog who waited at Shibuya Station for his deceased owner every day for nine years until 1935. The most popular meeting point in Tokyo.

pois.name: NHK Broadcasting Center
pois.description: Japan's public broadcaster since 1950, housed in a 48m complex in Yoyogi. Studio Park is open to visitors — walk through live TV sets.

pois.name: Shibuya Stream
pois.description: 2018 mixed-use tower (180m) built over the channelled Shibuya River. The promenade follows the original riverbed through cafes and terraces.
